features: Local Taste Engine: Offline, account-free algorithmic recommendation engine with skip tracking and taste mix generation
Local Taste Engine (Slice 2): Multi-source Last.fm recommendation pipeline (similar tracks, similar artists, top genres) with 1-hour taste snapshot caching and additive scoring bonuses
Local Taste Engine (Slice 3): Genre awareness with additive scoring bonus (+1.0), YouTube taste signals extraction, cross-screen generation status synchronization, and 'From Taste' quick action

Music Flow: optional full-screen vertical swipe discovery (Home shortcut) that plays personalized songs through the existing player, with like/playlist/share/lyrics actions, Not interested / Less like this feedback, Restore previous queue, offline downloaded-song fallback and settings under Settings → Music Flow

Android Auto: optional autoplay of the restored queue on automotive connect (Settings → Player, default off) and Home browse node with YouTube Home sections, suggested and recent content alongside local library
bug_fixes: Stats: fix NullPointerException crash when opening Stats by making SongWithStats thumbnailUrl and play counts safely nullable, removing unsafe forced unwraps, and guarding date sequence boundaries (#646)

Playback: fix custom addon (BitChord) queue repeating the first track audio when advancing, caused by stale trackedMediaItem metadata and loose title-only matching; resolve per-mediaId metadata with strict title+artist+duration match and addon-aware preload
Android Auto: fix Home shelves rendering without artwork and shuffle-led shelves ('Casuale') browsing empty, by falling back to the first item thumbnail and mapping musicShuffleRenderer
Android Auto: embed browse artwork in the media item so covers load without the app in the foreground, and stop replacing failed artwork lookups with a blank bitmap
Prevent missing song-ID map crashes in Quick Picks and Forgotten Favorites by keeping randomized Room relation queries stable across statement resets

Fix artist names containing & showing as "amp;" (e.g. "Sabin Rai, amp; The Pharaoh") by decoding HTML entities and dropping orphan entity fragments from YouTube Music API display text at the :innertube parse boundary
Music Flow: show the translucent play icon on album artwork only while paused, hide it during playback, and keep direct tap playback control
Music Flow: synchronize lyrics to playback and saved timing offsets, follow paused seeks and song changes, preserve instrumental gaps, and animate line changes with a smooth slide and fade
Music Flow: automatically scroll long song titles and artist names
Lyrics: time out stalled providers so other lyrics sources can be tried
Android Auto: deliver artwork as signed content URIs, cache cluster covers, stabilize Home shelves across reconnects, and fall back to hqdefault when maxresdefault 404s (#677)
Playback: fix downloaded track playback mismatch when filtering explicit/video songs, and recognize completed offline downloads when contentLength is unset (#666, #674)
Playlists: allow removing duplicate songs from a playlist directly from the 'Add to playlist' dialog and fix premature dialog dismissal (#655, #675)

Settings: remove stale search results for lyrics options that no longer exist (provider toggles, per-language romanization, glow effect), so searching settings no longer points to missing options (#700)
